visual_review: Brand, headline, location footer and CTA are complete and correctly spelled. Warm ivory/navy/gold editorial frame and readable hierarchy. Source patio wicker seating, fire table, pool and putting green remain recognizable; no people or invented amenity.
limitations: Generated panel is a reinterpretation of the source, not pixel-identical. Sky is more saturated and some furniture and fire details are redrawn. Overall estate layout and visible amenities remain consistent.
